entries.1007d00921d8e6cd: Profit attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥162,206 million, an increase of 20.0% from ¥135,165 million in the previous year, marking the fourth consecutive year of record profit. The company also achieved its consolidated business forecast for profit attributable to owners of the parent of ¥160.0 billion. The factors cited for the increase include recording multiple large asset sale gains in Real Estate, growth in the Aviation business, a decrease in credit-related expenses in the Americas business of Overseas Customers, and an increase in profit from the adjustment of the consolidation period due to a change in the fiscal year-end of a consolidated subsidiary. To acquire leased assets and make loans, the company raises substantial funds in domestic and foreign currencies, through both indirect financing from financial institution borrowings and direct financing through bonds, commercial paper, and securitization of lease receivables.
